messages:
jamie: Quick sync — we're launching SDK v3.7 staggered canaries tonight. Who's owning the first bucket (10%) and who'll be on smoke?
liam: I can own bucket-1 (10%) and run the smoke checks. What time window are we aiming for?
anika: Planning 22:00-23:30 UTC for canary 1. Will run smoke + minimal traffic for 30m then ramp to 25% if green.
yasmin: I'll handle client comms (changelog + notice). Will send out an API compatibility note to partners before the cutover. ETA 21:00 UTC.
tom: I'll be standby for rollback; I can trigger fallback and revert proxy rules. Share the rollback runbook link.
jamie: Rollback runbook snippet: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/revert -d '{"deploy": "sdk-v3.7","to": "v3.6"}'` — tom, that endpoint is rate-limited so call once.
liam: Smoke checklist (short):
- sanity generate on standard prompts (5)
- auth + token perms test
- throughput smoke (10 rps for 2 min)
- observe latency p50/p95 in console
I'll paste commands in #eng-ops when we start.
anika: Add an embedding regression check too — run `python infra/tests/embeds_check.py --sample 50`
yasmin: Client comms draft: "SDK v3.7 contains a minor API surface change: optional `client.timeout_ms` default reduced. Backwards compatible but please upgrade by 2024-12-15." Will include migration snippet.
jamie: Good. Also note we have a feature flag `sdk_v3_7_behavior` for 10%/25% buckets. Toggle names: `ff-sdk3.7-canary1` and `ff-sdk3.7-canary2`.
tom: Contacts for rollback: tom (pager), jamie (slack), liam (phone). Pager: +1-555-0100.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window: 2024-12-05 22:00:00 UTC -> canary-1 10% (ff-sdk3.7-canary1). Canary-2 25% at 22:45 UTC if all checks pass.
liam: I'll post timestamped smoke logs to the thread and create a short smoke report doc in the deployment board.
anika: If we see embedding cosine shift > 0.03 vs baseline, abort and rollback.
yasmin: I'll schedule a customer-facing post-upgrade note if canary stays green after 2 hrs.
jamie: Code owners: SDK core (liam), protocol shim (anika). Make sure PRs merged and CI green by 20:30 UTC.
liam: PRs merged, CI passing now. I'll re-run the integration tests at 21:45 UTC.
tom: I'll be on-call during the window. If anything goes wrong, escalate to infra-sre channel and call pager.
jamie: One more: metric alerts to watch — error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 2m, p95 latency > 1200ms. If tripped, rollback.
liam: Acknowledged. I'll have a quick rollback dry-run ready in case we need it.
anika: Are we keeping old client binary downloads for one week? 
yasmin: Yes, we'll keep v3.6 assets for 7 days and include a migration guide.
jamie: ok — looks like we're set. TL;DR: 22:00 UTC canary-1 (liam), 22:45 ramp to 25% (anika verify), tom rollback standby, yasmin client comms. Ping here when canary starts. :thumbsup:
